resources.string: Sandeshika needs to read your messages
Everything happens on this phone. Messages are read, sorted and shown here — none of them are uploaded, and nothing is sent anywhere.
Without message access there is nothing to organise. You can grant it in Settings → Apps → Sandeshika → Permissions.
Nothing needs your input right now.
This applies to all %1$d messages with the same wording, and teaches the app for future ones.
This teaches the app how to file messages like this one.
Long-press any message to correct how it is filed.

Builds a redacted summary of the messages that could not be categorised, so the rules can be improved.\n\nAmounts, account numbers, names, phone numbers, dates and links are replaced with placeholders. Personal messages and OTPs are left out entirely. Names from your contacts are removed from every message. You will see exactly what it contains before anything is shared, and can add any words the rules missed.
